name: Soushi Soumai ~Oya no Inu Aida ni...~
original_name: 相思相妹～親の居ぬ間に…～
source:
Maina is my little sister. 
She's always been cute to me, but lately 
she's so cute it's making me hurt. 
Guys at school are falling over themselves 
to try and win her. To steal her from me. 

Our parents are going on a 3-day vacation. 
The next 3 days, it's just us! 
Maina is all mine. 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE068333.html]DLsite English[/url]
translation:
妹菜是我的亲妹妹。
她一直都很可爱，可最近可爱得让我心口发疼。
学校里的男生个个争先恐后地追求她，
想把她从我身边抢走。

父母要外出旅行三天。
接下来三天，家里只有我们两个人！
妹菜完完全全属于我。

[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE068333.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
